ops.find: Unions have listed 45 specific strike calls

event.label: reported
event.text: Rennes unions say they will keep their route for the November 5 march despite a prefectural ban, and have counted 45 specific strike calls across sectors. Ouest-France reports that the CGT's Ille-et-Vilaine federation expects turnout to exceed the roughly 15,000 who marched on October 31.
